title: Dashboard grafiğinde node yerleşimini ve edge okunabilirliğini iyileştir
name: graph-reading
description: Mevcut Cytoscape canvas'ını gerçek board örnekleriyle incele; yoğun bağımlılık kümelerinde çapraz/uzun edge'leri ve ilişkisiz node'ların dağılımını azaltan, tekrar açıldığında kararlı ve çakışmasız bir yerleşim tasarla ve uygula. apps/dashboard/src/canvas/graph.ts içindeki pack/order ile Canvas.tsx ve paint.ts sunumunu birlikte değerlendir; gerekirse ADR 0040'taki halka yerleşimi kararının değişen gerekçesini yeni ADR'de kaydet. UI/UX incelemesinde hiyerarşi, taranabilirlik, edge yönü ve seçili node'un komşularının kolay izlenmesini; dar ekran, klavye erişimi ve reduced-motion davranışını ele al. Mevcut node seçimi, sürükleme/tow, filtreler ve panel akışını koru. Yerleşim ve görünür ilişki davranışını mevcut canvas testlerinde doğrula; demo/yoğun board üzerinde gözle incele.

brief.approach: Keep the existing preset Cytoscape layout. In apps/dashboard/src/canvas/graph.ts, replace ring seating in pack/order with a deterministic dependency-layer placement: derive layers from dependsOn, keep components together, order within layers by adjacent nodes, and leave spacing for labels. Preserve stable tie-breaking and no-overlap for islands, chains and dense joins. In apps/dashboard/src/canvas/Canvas.tsx preserve drag/tow, filters, selection, keyboard controls and reduced-motion behavior; adjust only fit/position handling needed by the coordinates. In apps/dashboard/src/canvas/paint.ts clarify dependency direction and selected-node neighbors within the existing palette. Update graph.test.ts and paint.test.ts with dense-DAG layout and visibility assertions. Inspect a dense demo board visually at desktop and narrow widths; document any change to ADR 0040's ring rationale in a new ADR. Use targeted checks, then commit.

acceptance.run: pnpm exec vitest run apps/dashboard/src/canvas/graph.test.ts apps/dashboard/src/canvas/paint.test.ts
acceptance.proves: Layout is stable and nonoverlapping on dense and sparse boards, and dependency and selected-neighbor styling stays readable.

acceptance.run: pnpm exec biome check apps/dashboard/src/canvas docs/adr && pnpm --filter @besober/dashboard build
acceptance.proves: Canvas code, tests and the layout ADR pass style checks and the dashboard compiles.

plain.what: Arrange nodes by their dependencies so dense boards are easier to read, while keeping current interactions.
plain.why: The present ring placement creates long, crossing lines in dense dependency groups.
plain.check: Run only canvas tests and dashboard build checks, then inspect a dense board at desktop and narrow sizes.
plain.risk: A new layout changes where nodes appear; stable ordering and interaction checks guard against confusing jumps.
